pr.title: fix(factory): relax Bindings and Variables for `createMiddleware`

summary: This is a type-only change to `createMiddleware`'s generic signature (adds an `AddAnyToEnv` helper defaulting missing `Bindings`/`Variables` to `any`), with no change to runtime logic — the implementation still just calls `createFactory<E2, P>().createMiddleware<I>(middleware)`. The fix intentionally loosens type-checking so nested middleware with partially-specified Env types compose without spurious TS errors; the only risk is that looser types could let genuinely mismatched Bindings/Variables slip past compile-time checks in edge cases, but that's an accepted tradeoff and a new test covers the reported scenario. No production/runtime behavior is affected.
